sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Fruit Samurai is a simple game that requires quick reflexes and a steady hand. The game is played using a mouse, with players using the left mouse button to slice and dice fruit and the right mouse button to activate special power-ups. The game starts off easy, with small pieces of fruit drifting lazily down the screen. As you progress through the levels, the fruit gets bigger, faster, and more aggressive, requiring you to be lightning-quick on the draw.

But what really adds depth to Fruit Samurai is its variety of power-ups and obstacles. These can be used strategically to clear entire screens of fruit at once, or to temporarily stun opponents and give you a competitive edge. With multiple levels and increasing difficulty, Fruit Samurai has a clear progression system that rewards players for their skills and progress.

As you get better at the game, you'll discover new ways to use the power-ups and obstacles to your advantage. For example, the 'bomb' power-up can clear an entire screen of fruit, but it can also trigger a 'chain reaction' that wipes out multiple screens at once. With practice and patience, you'll unlock new power-ups and obstacles, giving you an edge over your opponents and allowing you to play at a higher level.
